package.description: Open-source, cross-platform resume builder built with Electron, React, and Vite.

en-US.description: Open-source, cross-platform resume builder built with Electron, React, and Vite.
en-US.longDescription: OpenResume Builder is a free, open-source desktop resume builder with a live A4 preview, three templates, multiple named resume profiles, snapshots, rich-text editing, light and dark themes, and export to PDF, DOCX, and plain text. Resume data stays on the device and autosaves automatically.
en-US.name: OpenResume Builder
